description: The Croatian health statistics yearbook is the national annual compilation of health and health service statistics produced by the Croatian Institute of Public Health (HZJZ). Since the 2019 edition its tables are published as Excel files by chapter, alongside a PDF text edition. Chapters cover population and deaths; health institutions and health workers, such as the number of health centres, general, special and university hospitals and staff; primary care by activity; emergency medicine, with data from the Croatian Institute of Emergency Medicine; specialist and transfusion services; communicable diseases, HIV, tuberculosis and vaccination; inpatient care, day hospitals, one-day surgery and haemodialysis; births; chronic disease registers; and the health of older people. Coverage is national, with county detail in many tables, for editions 2019 to 2025. The files are free and available to download from the HZJZ site; no licence terms are stated. Caveats: recent tables are preliminary and revised later, table layouts vary between years, and facility-level data are not included. Simulation uses: sizing hospital and emergency medicine capacity by county, estimating baseline demand for surge scenarios and tracking health system performance after earthquakes such as those of 2020. Related records: GISCO healthcare services (data-gisco-healthcare-services-europe) map Croatian hospitals, and the WHO health infrastructure indicators (data-who-gho-health-infrastructure-indicators) give comparisons.
